$comment: Captured 10 Oct 2026 from the settings schema (zod) inside the installed Claude Code 2.1.289 binary (~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude-code/2.1.289/.../claude.app/Contents/MacOS/claude, read with strings; Claude Code was not run). Key names only, plus the defaults the schema's own descriptions state. `sandbox` is an object (no boolean form); unknown keys pass through (.passthrough()). Lists (excludedCommands, network.allowedDomains, network.allowUnixSockets, network.allowMachLookup, filesystem.allowWrite, ignoreViolations) merge across settings sources; network.strictAllowlist, allowAppleEvents, filesystem.disabled are honoured from user, managed or --settings only (project and local are ignored), and with strictAllowlist on the project's allowedDomains and WebFetch(domain:...) allow rules are left out. WebFetch(domain:...) allow rules merge into network.allowedDomains. Wildcards: *.example.com.

notConfirmed.hooksOutsideSandbox: The schema describes sandbox.enabled as running Bash commands inside the sandbox; the only hook sandboxing strings found are for remote-tools project hooks ('a project hook could not be run in the sandbox ... for a served call'). Ordinary hooks running outside the sandbox is indicated, not confirmed by a live run; doctor's probe write is the check.
